Title: Boulder City Council Study Session - October 12, 2023
Overview: Council reviewed three items: a Camp (Chautauqua/Shanahan-area) trailhead access management program update, the implementation process for East Boulder subcommunity plan zoning and form-based code, and a discussion of supporting Boulder County ballot measure 1A for open space sales and use tax extension. Council generally supported continuing Camp with planned changes and a feasibility study of direct transit access, asked staff to be cautious about raising fees on residents, and directed staff to refine form-based code review and bring back zoning recommendations; Council unanimously supported measure 1A, with a consent item planned for the next business meeting.

Topic1.Title: Camp Trailhead Access Management Program Update
Topic1.Summary: Staff recommended continuing the Camp park-to-park shuttle and paid parking program during its traditional summer season with planned changes such as micromobility, B-cycle station, signage and routing updates. Staff also proposed possible modifications including performance-based pricing, a commuter permit program for employees, and using parking revenue for TDM benefits. Staff requested a feasibility study of direct transit or microtransit access beyond the current park-and-ride model. Council members generally supported continuing Camp and exploring the feasibility study, but expressed caution about raising parking costs for city residents and the equity of access.

Topic2.Title: East Boulder Subcommunity Plan Zoning and Form-Based Code
Topic2.Summary: Staff presented the process update on implementing zoning recommendations from the East Boulder subcommunity plan, including a rezoning strategy and a review of the form-based code applied to Boulder Junction and Alpine-Balsam projects. Staff noted the code aims to deliver walkable neighborhoods but has drawn concerns about cost, design variety, and frequent discretionary call-ups. Council asked that feedback from the development community and planning board be incorporated, that discretionary review be limited, that rules be reassessed, and that roof variability and more iconic buildings be allowed. Staff will return with draft recommendations in a couple of months.

Topic3.Title: Support for Boulder County Ballot Measure 1A
Topic3.Summary: Council discussed supporting Boulder County ballot measure 1A, a 0.5% sales tax for open space purchase and maintenance. Councilmember Brockett raised the item and asked for council's temperature on a position of support. Council unanimously indicated support, and staff was directed to request that the item be placed on the consent agenda at the next business meeting.
